results.sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, COALESCE(s.sales_quantity, 0) AS sales_quantity, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY oi.product_id) AS s ON p.id = s.product_id ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 200
results.question: 统计每个商品的销量和销售额

results.sql: WITH paid_order_payment_methods AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.method, p.order_id FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID') SELECT pom.method, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_paid_order_amount FROM paid_order_payment_methods AS pom JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = pom.order_id GROUP BY pom.method ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 200
results.question: 不同支付方式对应的已支付订单总额是多少

results.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category LIMIT 200
results.question: 每个商品类别有多少位不同的购买客户

results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE c.region LIKE '%华南%' AND o.status = 'PAID' LIMIT 200
results.question: 华南地区客户购买过哪些商品

results.sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_product_count FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region LIMIT 200
results.question: 每个地区购买过多少种不同商品

results.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 200
results.question: 每个商品类别涉及多少个成交订单

results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.created_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.created_at < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
results.question: 2025年的GMV是多少

results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 成交订单数 FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.region = '华东' AND o.status = 'PAID' LIMIT 200
results.question: 华东客户区域的成交订单数

results.sql: SELECT p.name AS 产品名称, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量 FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 5
results.question: 产品销量排行榜前五名

results.sql: SELECT p.category AS "品类", SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS "成交额" FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY "成交额" DESC LIMIT 200
results.question: 各品类的成交额是多少
